connects_to.notes: No cable is published: the connection is known by function. The GPS board's own 5-pin connector J2 carries PPS, GPS_TX, GPS_RX, VDD3V3 and GND; the mainboard's P8 has four pins (GND, VDD3V3, UAR0_TX, UAR0_RX) and no PPS. On the owner's unit (MIA-M10Q board) the Kleidos firmware reads NMEA and UBX on IO44 and its UBX commands sent on IO43 take effect, and LILYGO gives the Grove pins (P8) to the GPS module; the GPS board's one connector J2 brings its supply, so it is fed from the always-on VDD3V3, the one supply P8 carries.

The active-antenna feed runs from VCC_RF through R4 (10 ohm) and L1 (27 nH) with C5 (10 nF) to GND. The Kleidos schematic numbers the GPS board's parts +100 (J103, C106, R104, L101, C105), since they repeat the mainboard's designators.

components.notes: LILYGO also publishes a T-Deck-L76K V1.0 board (Quectel L76K, RESET_N pulled up by 10 kOhm R1 with C4 100 nF, VBACKUP from VRTC, the same 5-pin J2 and MS412FE backup cell). The GPS takes the Grove seat's pins, so the Grove connector cannot be used for anything else on the Plus.

notes: LILYGO publishes one mainboard schematic for the T-Deck family (dated 2023-06-01) and links it from the T-Deck Plus page; the GNSS parts come from its separate GPS daughterboard sheets (T-Deck-GPS V1.0, T-Deck-L76K V1.0). Three rails: VDD3V3 from the buck while SW1 is on, V3V and BAT switched from it by PWR_EN (IO10). Designators are the schematic's. The case has no speaker grille (owner observed on his unit, 2026-11-17): six holes on the lower side edge, the speaker behind the PCB at the bottom-right corner. The slot above the screen, drawn by measurements.json, svg/front.svg and the model, is of undocumented purpose: LILYGO's specification and pin-map images draw it without a label, and its documentation page and repository name nothing there.
